sermon.title: 10 Factual Experiences Not by Faith or Grace 01/26/2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer looks at Simeon and Anna when Jesus was brought to the temple. Simeon was just and devout, the Holy Ghost was upon him and revealed he would see Christ, and he was led there in time; Anna, a hundred-year-old prophetess, served God with fasting and prayer. These were factual experiences, not faith or grace alone, and they pointed to Jesus.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Captions render “inner court” oddly in two places; those are marked [unclear].
